title: Microsoft Premier Partner | Quadra
description: Quadra is a Microsoft Premier Partner with 25+ years of Azure, Modern Work, and Security expertise. We help enterprises architect, migrate, and manage Microsoft cloud environments for lasting competitive advantage.

blocks.text: We are a premier Microsoft solutions partner, leveraging the full, integrated power of the Microsoft ecosystem to architect the secure, intelligent, and future-ready enterprise your ambition demands.
20 Consecutive Years of Microsoft Global Recognition

For two decades, through every major technology shift, Quadra has been honored by Microsoft at a global level for our innovation, customer impact, and ability to deliver on the promise of their technology. This unbroken streak is a testament to our enduring quality and our ability to architect solutions that keep our partners ahead of the curve. It is the ultimate proof of our stability and expertise
Azure (Infrastructure, Data & AI, Digital & App Innovation), Modern Work, Security.
Windows Server & SQL Migration, Meetings & Meeting Rooms for Microsoft Teams, Identity and Access Management, Threat Protection.
Among the first and top-performing partners globally, accelerating successful cloud adoption and ensuring rapid ROI.
The Blueprint for Your Microsoft Ecosystem
Our practice is built on three integrated pillars, designed to architect a cohesive, intelligent, and fortified enterprise on the Microsoft Cloud.
Modernize Your Foundation & Innovate with AI

We architect and manage scalable, secure, and AI-ready infrastructure on Microsoft Azure. We help you migrate and modernize legacy applications, build powerful data platforms with Microsoft Fabric, and innovate with Azure AI and OpenAI services.

For a high-growth financial services ISV encumbered by a complex, multi-vendor environment, we architected a complete "all-in" migration to the Microsoft Cloud. This strategic consolidation provided a single, secure platform for both their infrastructure and their workforce productivity.
Accelerated their product roadmap using Azure Machine Learning
Unified their entire business on a single, secure, and intelligent platform
Our 20-year history gives us unparalleled access and influence within Microsoft. This translates into deeper insights, better support, and a stronger advocacy for your business needs.

We see the Microsoft Cloud as one powerful, integrated platform. Our cross-functional teams ensure your Azure, Modern Work, and Security solutions are architected to work together seamlessly, maximizing value and minimizing complexity

We combine award-winning custom IP on the Power Platform with the power of a deeply experienced team. Our unique culture of employee longevity ensures your projects are guided by consistent, expert hands from start to finish.
Schedule a strategic session with our Microsoft architects to map out the blueprint for your enterprise ambition.
